title: Savings circle
summary: A savings circle (a gam'eya, a tontine, a committee): everyone puts the same part in each month and one person takes the pot each month. Say the people, the part, your turn and the first month, and the months and your payout are written as a plan's parts, so Cash ahead and Coming up count them.
changes: The Savings circle widget on Today says No circle yet when you are in none, rather than A month £0.
author: BrainDog
